commit.message:
fix(sdk): validate installed Runtime origins before launch

Port the approved source-identity and host-bootstrap origin repair onto the
current integration tree. Resolve the selected installed modules with the
isolated interpreter's leaf PathFinder lookups, validate all eight execution
origins, and check Runtime package identity before execution imports.

Add bounded installed positive and negative controls without changing D13
consumer paths.

+"""Executable source measurement, usable before importing Runtime code."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib.machinery
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _canonical_digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _source_digest(root: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash the complete executor source tree without retaining a source path in a task."""
+    entries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    if root.is_file():
+        return hashlib.sha256(root.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
+        if not path.is_file() or "__pycache__" in path.parts:
+            continue
+        entries.append((str(path.relative_to(root)), hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
+    return _canonical_digest(entries)
+
+
+def source_checkout_closure(checkout: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Measure the executable host closure owned by this checkout.
+
+    The legacy pack digest remains the capability-admission identity.  This
+    separate receipt covers the process host, Astrid core, SDK/bootstrap,
+    package entrypoints, launcher, vendored workspace-client files, and the
+    Runtime packages in an installed pair that can change execution.
+    """
+    root = Path(checkout).expanduser().resolve()
+    components = {
+        "host": root / "astrid" / "core" / "execution" / "generic_host.py",
+        "core": root / "astrid" / "core",
+        "sdk": root / "astrid" / "sdk",
+        "launcher": root / "astrid" / "omp_agent.py",
+        "astrid_entrypoint": root / "astrid" / "__init__.py",
+        "astrid_version": root / "astrid" / "version.py",
+        "astrid_main": root / "astrid" / "__main__.py",
+        "astrid_runtime_cli": root / "astrid" / "runtime_cli.py",
+        "vendored_workspace_client": root / "astrid_runtime_client",
+    }
+    # Source checkouts keep their existing Agent closure. An installed pair
+    # contributes both Runtime packages to the same existing digest carrier.
+    runtime_names = ("runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime")
+    if any((root / name).exists() or (root / name).is_symlink() for name in runtime_names):
+        components.update({name: root / name for name in runtime_names})
+    measured: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for name, path in components.items():
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.exists():
+            raise ValueError(f"source closure component is missing or symlinked: {name}")
+        if path.is_dir() and any(child.is_symlink() for child in path.rglob("*")):
+            raise ValueError(f"source closure component contains a symlink: {name}")
+        measured.append({
+            "component": name,
+            "path": str(path.relative_to(root)),
+            "sha256": _source_digest(path),
+        })
+    measured.sort(key=lambda item: item["component"])
+    return {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "components": measured,
+        "digest": _canonical_digest(measured),
+    }
+
+
+def source_checkout_closure_digest(checkout: str | Path) -> str:
+    """Return the deterministic digest for the executable source closure."""
+    return str(source_checkout_closure(checkout)["digest"])
+
+
+def installed_runtime_origins(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Resolve required Runtime code without executing package initializers."""
+    root = root.absolute()
+    origins = {}
+    for name in ("runtime_protocol", "runtime_protocol.platform", "astrid_runtime"):
+        parent = name.rpartition(".")[0]
+        search = [str(root / parent)] if parent else sys.path
+        spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(name, search)
+        expected = root.joinpath(*name.split("."))
+        expected = expected / "__init__.py" if not parent else expected.with_suffix(".py")
+        if spec is None or spec.origin != str(expected):
+            raise ValueError(f"installed Runtime origin differs or is missing: {name}")
+        if (not expected.is_file()
+                or any(path.is_symlink() for path in (expected, *expected.parents))):
+            raise ValueError(f"installed Runtime origin is missing or symlinked: {name}")
+        if spec.submodule_search_locations is not None and list(spec.submodule_search_locations) != [str(expected.parent)]:
+            raise ValueError(f"installed Runtime package search path differs: {name}")
+        origins[name] = str(expected)
+    for name in ("runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime"):
+        if any(path.is_symlink() for path in (root / name).rglob("*")):
+            raise ValueError(f"installed Runtime package contains a symlink: {name}")
+    return origins
+
+
+def verify_installed_host_startup() -> None:
+    """Check the existing launch binding before execution-package imports."""
+    original = sys.orig_argv
+    if (not sys.flags.isolated or sys.argv[:1] != ["-m"] or "-m" not in original
+            or original[original.index("-m") + 1:original.index("-m") + 2]
+            != ["astrid.core.execution.generic_host"]):
+        return
+    # The selected interpreter's actual package tree is authority. The launch
+    # checkout must name it, never supply a different import root.
+    root = Path(__file__).absolute().parents[2]
+    def argument(name: str) -> str:
+        if sys.argv.count(name) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"installed host requires one {name}")
+        index = sys.argv.index(name) + 1
+        if index >= len(sys.argv):
+            raise ValueError(f"installed host requires a value for {name}")
+        return sys.argv[index]
+    if argument("--source-checkout") != str(root):
+        raise ValueError("installed host source differs from selected interpreter tree")
+    installed_runtime_origins(root)
+    expected = argument("--source-closure-digest").removeprefix("sha256:")
+    if source_checkout_closure_digest(root) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("installed host executable source closure mismatch")

+"""Bounded installed import probes; no Runtime server, renderer, or sockets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import venv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from astrid.core.source_identity import _source_digest, source_checkout_closure
+from astrid.sdk.host_bootstrap import PackHostBootstrapError, _installed_execution_origins
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def installed_pair(tmp_path):
+    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=tmp_path) as temporary:
+        private = Path(temporary)
+        environment = private / "venv"
+        venv.EnvBuilder(with_pip=False, symlinks=False).create(environment)
+        python = environment / "bin/python"
+        site = next((environment / "lib").glob("python*/site-packages"))
+        ignore = shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc")
+        shutil.copytree(source / "astrid", site / "astrid", ignore=ignore)
+        shutil.copy2(source / "pyproject.toml", site / "pyproject.toml")
+        for name in ("astrid_runtime_client", "runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime"):
+            spec = importlib.util.find_spec(name)
+            assert spec is not None and spec.origin
+            shutil.copytree(Path(spec.origin).parent, site / name, ignore=ignore)
+        # Only dependency files are borrowed read-only; no shared .pth is run.
+        dependencies = Path(sys.executable).parent.parent / "lib" / f"python{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}" / "site-packages"
+        (site / "test-dependencies.pth").write_text(str(dependencies) + "\n")
+        neutral = private / "neutral"
+        neutral.mkdir()
+        env = {"HOME": str(private), "PATH": os.defpath, "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
+               "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
+        yield site, str(python), neutral, env
+
+
+def _host_import(pair, digest):
+    site, python, neutral, env = pair
+    return subprocess.run(
+        [python, "-I", "-B", "-m", "astrid.core.execution.generic_host", "--help",
+         "--source-checkout", str(site), "--source-closure-digest", digest],
+        cwd=neutral, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30,
+    )
+
+
+def test_exact_installed_pair_passes_real_origin_and_child_checks(installed_pair):
+    site, python, neutral, env = installed_pair
+    origins = _installed_execution_origins(site, python)
+    assert set(origins) == {"host", "child", "action", "client", "sdk",
+                            "runtime_protocol", "runtime_protocol.platform", "astrid_runtime"}
+    assert all(Path(origin).is_relative_to(site) for origin in origins.values())
+    closure = source_checkout_closure(site)
+    assert {"runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime"} <= {row["component"] for row in closure["components"]}
+    child = _host_import(installed_pair, closure["digest"])
+    assert child.returncode == 0, child.stderr
+    assert "astrid-generic-host" in child.stdout
+    actual = subprocess.run(
+        [python, "-I", "-B", "-c",
+         "from astrid.core.rendering import remotion_runtime; print(remotion_runtime.platform.__file__)"],
+        cwd=neutral, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30,
+    )
+    assert actual.returncode == 0, actual.stderr
+    assert Path(actual.stdout.strip()) == site / "runtime_protocol/platform.py"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("package", ["runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime"])
+def test_foreign_runtime_symlink_refused_before_package_code(installed_pair, package):
+    site, python, neutral, _ = installed_pair
+    digest = source_checkout_closure(site)["digest"]
+    foreign = neutral / "foreign-runtime"
+    shutil.move(site / package, foreign)
+    marker = neutral / "foreign-imported"
+    with (foreign / "__init__.py").open("a") as stream:
+        stream.write(f"\nfrom pathlib import Path\nPath({str(marker)!r}).touch()\n")
+    (site / package).symlink_to(foreign, target_is_directory=True)
+    with pytest.raises(PackHostBootstrapError, match="actual installed"):
+        _installed_execution_origins(site, python)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="symlink"):
+        source_checkout_closure(site)
+    child = _host_import(installed_pair, digest)
+    assert child.returncode != 0
+    assert "installed Runtime" in child.stderr
+    assert not marker.exists()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("packages", [("runtime_protocol",), ("astrid_runtime",), ("runtime_protocol", "astrid_runtime")])
+def test_missing_required_runtime_refuses_visibly(installed_pair, packages):
+    site, python, _, _ = installed_pair
+    digest = source_checkout_closure(site)["digest"]
+    for package in packages:
+        shutil.rmtree(site / package)
+    with pytest.raises(PackHostBootstrapError, match="actual installed"):
+        _installed_execution_origins(site, python)
+    child = _host_import(installed_pair, digest)
+    assert child.returncode != 0
+    assert "installed Runtime origin differs or is missing" in child.stderr

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("substitution", ["source", "native_source", "symlink", "platform_symlink"])
+def test_runtime_substitution_after_real_probe_fenced_at_child_import(installed_pair, substitution):
+    site, python, neutral, _ = installed_pair
+    _installed_execution_origins(site, python)
+    agent_digest = _source_digest(site / "astrid")
+    digest = source_checkout_closure(site)["digest"]
+    marker = neutral / "foreign-imported"
+    platform = site / ("astrid_runtime/bootstrap.py" if substitution == "native_source" else "runtime_protocol/platform.py")
+    with platform.open("a") as stream:
+        stream.write(f"\nfrom pathlib import Path\nPath({str(marker)!r}).touch()\n")
+    if substitution == "symlink":
+        foreign = neutral / "foreign-runtime"
+        shutil.move(site / "runtime_protocol", foreign)
+        (site / "runtime_protocol").symlink_to(foreign, target_is_directory=True)
+    elif substitution == "platform_symlink":
+        foreign = neutral / "foreign-platform.py"
+        shutil.move(platform, foreign)
+        platform.symlink_to(foreign)
+    assert _source_digest(site / "astrid") == agent_digest
+    if substitution in {"source", "native_source"}:
+        assert source_checkout_closure(site)["digest"] != digest
+    child = _host_import(installed_pair, digest)
+    assert child.returncode != 0
+    assert ("source closure mismatch" if substitution in {"source", "native_source"} else "symlink") in child.stderr
+    assert not marker.exists()
+
